free.title: Harry Styles Lookalike Contest at RiseNY
free.caption:
FREE · TIMES SQUARE

Dress like Harry Styles today and you could end up with tickets to see him live - no entry fee required.

RiseNY in Times Square is running a free Harry Styles lookalike contest this afternoon, 5 to 6pm only. Show up in your best fit from any era and two winners will each walk away with a pair of tickets to see him live at Madison Square Garden.

No registration, no cover charge, just walk in during the window. Judging happens on the spot, so commit to one era instead of a mashup look.

Tag whoever you would drag into this with you.

📷 RiseNY

food.title: Bartel-Pritchard Square Greenmarket
food.caption:
FOOD · PARK SLOPE

Prospect Park has had a farm stand at its own front gate since 1996, and most people walk right past it.

Bartel-Pritchard Square Greenmarket runs every Wednesday from 8am to 2pm at the Prospect Park West entrance - six vendors selling fresh seafood, pasture-raised eggs, sourdough, grass-fed beef, and orchard fruit, rain or shine.

Get there before 9am if you want first pick of the bread and seafood, and bring the park walk you were already planning - the Long Meadow entrance is right there.

Save this for your next Wednesday morning.

📷 GrowNYC

art.title: 6 Secrets of Carnegie Hall
art.caption:
HIDDEN GEM · MIDTOWN

Carnegie Hall has stood on 7th Avenue since 1891, and most people walk past without knowing it was almost torn down.

Andrew Carnegie built it after his wife and a conductor talked him into it, and Tchaikovsky conducted opening night. Architect William Tuthill, an amateur cellist, skipped curtains and chandeliers on purpose to protect the acoustics - the hall runs on steel trusses with no interior columns, like a bridge. Bernstein wrote West Side Story in an upstairs studio here, and in 1960 violinist Isaac Stern led the fight that saved the building from demolition.

Next time you're on 57th Street, look up at the lobby ceiling - the trusses are still there.

Save this before your next Midtown walk.

📷 Untapped New York
